title: SLPK Hash Table
description: Scanning an SLPK (ZIP store) containing millions of documents is usually inefficient and slow. A hash table file may be added to the SLPK to improve first load and file scanning performances. A hash table is a data structure that implements an associative array abstract data type, a structure that can map keys to values. A hash table uses a hash function to compute an index, also called a hash code, into an array of buckets or slots, from which the desired value can be found (Wikipedia).
